expectations.text: States there are no new controller/processor controls to implement; the work is re-mapping evidence to the new numbering and structure
expectations.evidence: 'The 31 controller controls and 18 processor controls carry over one-for-one... no new controls. Re-reference your SoA and evidence'

expectations.text: Gives the transition deadlines: certification bodies by October 31, 2027 and certified organizations by October 31, 2028
expectations.evidence: Org date hedged ('1 or 31 October 2028') and CB date given as 'around 31 October 2026', not October 31, 2027

expectations.text: Notes the 2025 edition is standalone certifiable (no ISO 27001 certificate prerequisite), with the shared A.3 block to account for
expectations.evidence: Standalone edition, ISO 27001 no longer prerequisite ('Without ISO 27001, the 29 controls must be independently evidenced'), Table A.3 addressed

expectations.text: Does not instruct implementing 'new' retention, disposal or transmission controls
